purpose: Ask which row label refers to a review outcome. The model must copy a label or reply NONE. It must not return a cell value. Table selection stays with the dual-axis locator; this prompt does not pick the table.
boundary: The RENDERED prompt bytes. Comments and helper names are outside the boundary.
